title: Modeling Social Dynamics with an LLM-Enabled Agent Based Network-Dynamic (LAND) Model
abstract: arXiv:2608.00929v2 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: Social dynamics encode the process in which individual network and discourse interactions aggregate into collective influence, narrative dominance and coordinate behavior. This paper uses the the GhostField architecture, a hybrid LLM-Enabled Agent Based Network-Dynamic (LAND) model as a social simulation framework to build the AuraSight scenario. In the AuraSight scenario, 314,244 heterogeneous cyber social agents and human actors exchange 529,327 messages over 30 days surrounding a fictional international song-writing contest. We methodologically examine emergent social dynamics across four analytical layers: ego-network topology, semantic network evolution, coordination dynamics and influence dynamics. Our results show how generated social simulations do also produce social dynamics, and how the dynamics of coordination and influence emerge not from individual agents but from the recursive interaction between network topology and n

translated_title: 使用大语言模型赋能的基于智能体的网络-动态（LAND）模型建模社会动态
translated_abstract: 社会动态编码了个体网络与话语交互聚合为集体影响、叙事主导和协调行为的过程。本文采用GhostField架构——一种混合式的大语言模型赋能的基于智能体的网络-动态（LAND）模型——作为社会仿真框架，构建了AuraSight场景。在AuraSight场景中，314,244个异构网络社会智能体与人类行为者在30天内围绕一场虚构的国际歌曲创作比赛交换了529,327条消息。我们从方法学层面考察了四个分析维度上的涌现社会动态：自我网络拓扑、语义网络演化、协调动态和影响动态。我们的研究结果表明，生成式社会仿真同样能够产生社会动态，且协调与影响的动态并非源于单个智能体，而是源于网络拓扑与……（原文摘要在此处截断）
tldr: 本文提出基于大语言模型的混合式LAND社会仿真框架（GhostField架构），通过AuraSight场景中31万余个异构智能体在30天内交换52万余条消息的模拟，从网络拓扑、语义网络、协调与影响四个层面揭示了社会动态的涌现机制。
en_tdlr: This paper introduces GhostField, a hybrid LLM-enabled agent-based network-dynamic (LAND) social simulation framework, and demonstrates through the AuraSight scenario—where over 314,000 heterogeneous agents exchange 529,000+ messages over 30 days—how emergent social dynamics of coordination and influence arise across ego-network topology, semantic evolution, coordination, and influence layers.
